name: Ocean Beach
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Ocean Beach?
answer_short: A street-legal LSV can drive on Ocean Beach streets posted 35 mph or less under CVC 21260. A plain golf cart is limited to streets posted 25 mph or less in a business or residence district (CVC 21716). Freeways like I-5 are off limits. Posted signs win.

lsv.notes: May cross faster roads at intersections

rules.rule: Only roads posted 35 mph or less
Roads posted 25 mph or less in a business or residence district

faq.q: Can an LSV drive on a 40 mph road in Ocean Beach?
faq.a: No. California limits LSVs to roads posted 35 mph or less (CVC 21260). They may cross a faster road at an intersection.

faq.q: Can a regular golf cart drive on Ocean Beach streets?
faq.a: Only on streets posted 25 mph or less in a business or residence district (CVC 21716), unless a local golf cart plan says otherwise.
